project_outcome.statement: No improved zero-density coefficient, prime-interval endpoint, or L-function-family transfer is proved. The checked baseline remains density coefficient 30/13, with uniform and almost-all interval endpoints 17/30 and 2/15.

The live obstruction is to derive the strict branch's actual normalized coefficient weights and uniform complete per-mode capacity bound.

progress_criterion.statement: Cycle 154 advances E14D-L only by deriving the actual strict branch's positive-weight normalization and uniform complete bound needed by Cycle 152, thereby yielding an actual labelled fan, or by a finite reason-labelled quantitative escape decomposition. A conditional fan, an unlabelled residual, heuristic cancellation, a scalar collision bound, or isolated endpoint norm aggregation does not advance the actual gate.
